steps.desc: Build external minimal dynamic libc ftruncate counter probe only
steps.cmd: set -eu; raw=/home/newton/work/dev-hermit/ignored/liteinst-ftruncate-cause-20260904; source=/home/newton/work/dev-hermit/experiments/liteinst_architecture_20260904/ftruncate-counter-probe.c; cc -std=c11 -O2 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror "$source" -ldl -o "$raw/ftruncate-counter-probe" > "$raw/compile.log" 2>&1; sha256sum "$source" "$raw/ftruncate-counter-probe" > "$raw/fixture.sha256"; file "$raw/ftruncate-counter-probe" > "$raw/fixture-elf.txt"; readelf -l "$raw/ftruncate-counter-probe" >> "$raw/fixture-elf.txt"; readelf -Ws "$raw/ftruncate-counter-probe" | grep ftruncate > "$raw/fixture-libc-symbol.txt"

steps.desc: Native libc ftruncate control on anonymous and regular writable files
steps.cmd: set -eu; raw=/home/newton/work/dev-hermit/ignored/liteinst-ftruncate-cause-20260904; output=$raw/native; mkdir "$output"; row=/home/newton/work/dev-hermit/ignored/liteinst-host-hybrid-pairs-20260904/e2e/03_tmpfile_ptrace/results.jsonl; mapfile -d '' -t variables < <(jq -j '.env | to_entries[] | .key + "=" + .value + "\u0000"' "$row"); cd "$(jq -r '.artifact_dir + "/workdir/1"' "$row")"; pwd > "$output/cwd.txt"; printf '%s\n' PATH=/usr/bin:/bin "${variables[@]}" > "$output/environment.txt"; date -u +%FT%TZ > "$output/started.txt"; sha256sum "$raw/ftruncate-counter-probe" /lib64/libc.so.6 > "$output/executed.sha256"; ulimit -c 0; ulimit -f 1024; set +e; env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin "${variables[@]}" timeout --signal=KILL 30 "$raw/ftruncate-counter-probe" native > "$output/guest.stdout" 2> "$output/guest.stderr"; status=$?; printf '%s\n' "$status" > "$output/exit.txt"; date -u +%FT%TZ > "$output/ended.txt"; exit "$status"

steps.desc: Same libc ftruncate control with frozen typed shared Detcore and existing refusal counters
steps.cmd: set -eu; raw=/home/newton/work/dev-hermit/ignored/liteinst-ftruncate-cause-20260904; output=$raw/typed; logging=/home/newton/work/dev-hermit/ignored/liteinst-logging-teardown-20260904; mkdir "$output"; row=/home/newton/work/dev-hermit/ignored/liteinst-host-hybrid-pairs-20260904/e2e/03_tmpfile_ptrace/results.jsonl; mapfile -d '' -t variables < <(jq -j '.env | to_entries[] | .key + "=" + .value + "\u0000"' "$row"); cd "$(jq -r '.artifact_dir + "/workdir/1"' "$row")"; pwd > "$output/cwd.txt"; printf '%s\n' PATH=/usr/bin:/bin "${variables[@]}" > "$output/environment.txt"; date -u +%FT%TZ > "$output/started.txt"; sha256sum "$raw/ftruncate-counter-probe" "$logging/target-hermit/debug/liteinst-detcore-strict-probe" "$logging/target-hermit/debug/libhermit_liteinst_detcore.so" /home/newton/work/dev-hermit/ignored/liteinst-detcore-isolated-20260904/deny-ptrace /lib64/libc.so.6 > "$output/executed.sha256"; ulimit -c 0; ulimit -f 1024; set +e; env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin "${variables[@]}" timeout --signal=KILL 30 /home/newton/work/dev-hermit/ignored/liteinst-detcore-isolated-20260904/deny-ptrace "$logging/target-hermit/debug/liteinst-detcore-strict-probe" "$logging/target-hermit/debug/libhermit_liteinst_detcore.so" "$output" "$raw/ftruncate-counter-probe" typed > "$output/coordinator.stdout" 2> "$output/coordinator.stderr"; status=$?; printf '%s\n' "$status" > "$output/exit.txt"; date -u +%FT%TZ > "$output/ended.txt"; exit "$status"
